Each review takes one paper or tool apart: how it works, what is genuinely new, how well the evidence holds up, whether the code actually runs, and where it fits in a real analysis workflow. Reviews are tagged by **field** (AI, bioinformatics, computational biology) and **type** (paper, tool, benchmark).

*Opinions are my own and do not represent my employer.*
